LOADB.description: sets register to boolean and jumps to a given short offset (used to compile comparison results into a boolean)

LOADN.description: sets register to a number literal

LOADK.description: sets register to an entry from the constant table from the proto (number/vector/string)

MOVE.description: move (copy) value from one register to another

GETGLOBAL.description: load value from global table using constant string as a key
details: C: predicted slot index (based on hash)

SETGLOBAL.description: set value in global table using constant string as a key
details: C: predicted slot index (based on hash)

GETUPVAL.description: load upvalue from the upvalue table for the current function

SETUPVAL.description: store value into the upvalue table for the current function

CLOSEUPVALS.description: close (migrate to heap) all upvalues that were captured for registers >= target

GETIMPORT.description: load imported global table global from the constant table
details: D: constant table index (0..32767); we assume that imports are loaded into the constant table
AUX: 3 10-bit indices of constant strings that, combined, constitute an import path; length of the path is set by the top 2 bits (1,2,3)

GETTABLE.description: load value from table into target register using key from register

SETTABLE.description: store source register into table using key from register

GETTABLEKS.description: load value from table into target register using constant string as a key
details: C: predicted slot index (based on hash)

SETTABLEKS.description: store source register into table using constant string as a key
details: C: predicted slot index (based on hash)

GETTABLEN.description: load value from table into target register using small integer index as a key

SETTABLEN.description: store source register into table using small integer index as a key

NEWCLOSURE.description: create closure from a child proto; followed by a CAPTURE instruction for each upvalue

NAMECALL.description: prepare to call specified method by name by loading function from source register using constant index into target register and copying source register into target register + 1
details: C: predicted slot index (based on hash)
Note that this instruction must be followed directly by CALL; it prepares the arguments
This instruction is roughly equivalent to GETTABLEKS + MOVE pair, but we need a special instruction to support custom __namecall metamethod
A: register where the function object lives, followed by arguments; results are placed starting from the same register
B: argument count + 1, or 0 to preserve all arguments up to top (MULTRET)
C: result count + 1, or 0 to preserve all values and adjust top (MULTRET)

RETURN.description: returns specified values from the function
details: A: register where the returned values start
B: number of returned values + 1, or 0 to return all values up to top (MULTRET)
D: jump offset (-32768..32767; 0 means "next instruction" aka "don't jump")

JUMPBACK.description: jumps to target offset; this is equivalent to JUMP but is used as a safepoint to be able to interrupt while/repeat loops
details: D: jump offset (-32768..32767; 0 means "next instruction" aka "don't jump")

JUMPIF.description: jumps to target offset if register is not nil/false
details: D: jump offset (-32768..32767; 0 means "next instruction" aka "don't jump")

JUMPIFNOT.description: jumps to target offset if register is nil/false
details: D: jump offset (-32768..32767; 0 means "next instruction" aka "don't jump")

JUMPIFEQ.description: jumps to target offset if the comparison is true (or false, for NOT variants)
details: D: jump offset (-32768..32767; 1 means "next instruction" aka "don't jump")

JUMPIFLE.description: jumps to target offset if the comparison is true (or false, for NOT variants)
details: D: jump offset (-32768..32767; 1 means "next instruction" aka "don't jump")

JUMPIFLT.description: jumps to target offset if the comparison is true (or false, for NOT variants)
details: D: jump offset (-32768..32767; 1 means "next instruction" aka "don't jump")

JUMPIFNOTEQ.description: jumps to target offset if the comparison is true (or false, for NOT variants)
details: D: jump offset (-32768..32767; 1 means "next instruction" aka "don't jump")

JUMPIFNOTLE.description: jumps to target offset if the comparison is true (or false, for NOT variants)
details: D: jump offset (-32768..32767; 1 means "next instruction" aka "don't jump")

JUMPIFNOTLT.description: jumps to target offset if the comparison is true (or false, for NOT variants)
details: D: jump offset (-32768..32767; 1 means "next instruction" aka "don't jump")

ADD.description: compute arithmetic operation between two source registers and put the result into target register

SUB.description: compute arithmetic operation between two source registers and put the result into target register

MUL.description: compute arithmetic operation between two source registers and put the result into target register

DIV.description: compute arithmetic operation between two source registers and put the result into target register

MOD.description: compute arithmetic operation between two source registers and put the result into target register

POW.description: compute arithmetic operation between two source registers and put the result into target register

ADDK.description: compute arithmetic operation between the source register and a constant and put the result into target register
details: C: constant table index (0..255); must refer to a number

SUBK.description: compute arithmetic operation between the source register and a constant and put the result into target register
details: C: constant table index (0..255); must refer to a number

MULK.description: compute arithmetic operation between the source register and a constant and put the result into target register
details: C: constant table index (0..255); must refer to a number

DIVK.description: compute arithmetic operation between the source register and a constant and put the result into target register
details: C: constant table index (0..255); must refer to a number

MODK.description: compute arithmetic operation between the source register and a constant and put the result into target register
details: C: constant table index (0..255); must refer to a number

POWK.description: compute arithmetic operation between the source register and a constant and put the result into target register
details: C: constant table index (0..255); must refer to a number

AND.description: perform `and` or `or` operation (selecting first or second register based on whether the first one is truthy) and put the result into target register

OR.description: perform `and` or `or` operation (selecting first or second register based on whether the first one is truthy) and put the result into target register

ANDK.description: perform `and` or `or` operation (selecting source register or constant based on whether the source register is truthy) and put the result into target register

ORK.description: perform `and` or `or` operation (selecting source register or constant based on whether the source register is truthy) and put the result into target register

CONCAT.description: concatenate all strings between B and C (inclusive) and put the result into A

NOT.description: compute unary operation for source register and put the result into target register

MINUS.description: compute unary operation for source register and put the result into target register

LENGTH.description: compute unary operation for source register and put the result into target register

details: B: table size, stored as 0 for v=0 and ceil(log2(v))+1 for v!=0

DUPTABLE.description: duplicate table using the constant table template to target register

SETLIST.description: set a list of values to table in target register
details: C: value count + 1, or 0 to use all values up to top (MULTRET)
AUX: table index to start from

FORNPREP.description: prepare a numeric for loop, jump over the loop if first iteration doesn't need to run
details: A: target register; numeric for loops assume a register layout [limit, step, index, variable]
limit/step are immutable, index isn't visible to user code since it's copied into variable

FORNLOOP.description: adjust loop variables for one iteration, jump back to the loop header if loop needs to continue
details: A: target register; see FORNPREP for register layout

FORGLOOP.description: adjust loop variables for one iteration of a generic for loop, jump back to the loop header if loop needs to continue
details: A: target register; generic for loops assume a register layout [generator, state, index, variables...]
AUX: variable count (1..255) in the low 8 bits, high bit indicates whether to use ipairs-style traversal in the fast path
loop variables are adjusted by calling generator(state, index) and expecting it to return a tuple that's copied to the user variables
the first variable is then copied into index; generator/state are immutable, index isn't visible to user code

FORGPREP_INEXT.description: prepare FORGLOOP with 2 output variables (no AUX encoding), assuming generator is luaB_inext, and jump to FORGLOOP
details: A: target register (see FORGLOOP for register layout)

FASTCALL3.description: perform a fast call of a built-in function using 3 register arguments
details: C: jump offset to get to following CALL
AUX: source register 2 in least-significant byte
AUX: source register 3 in second least-significant byte

FORGPREP_NEXT.description: prepare FORGLOOP with 2 output variables (no AUX encoding), assuming generator is luaB_next, and jump to FORGLOOP
details: A: target register (see FORGLOOP for register layout)

NATIVECALL.description: start executing new function in native code
details: this is a pseudo-instruction that is never emitted by bytecode compiler, but can be constructed at runtime to accelerate native code dispatch

GETVARARGS.description: copy variables into the target register from vararg storage for current function
details: B: variable count + 1, or 0 to copy all variables and adjust top (MULTRET)

DUPCLOSURE.description: create closure from a pre-created function object (reusing it unless environments diverge)

PREPVARARGS.description: prepare stack for variadic functions so that GETVARARGS works correctly

LOADKX.description: sets register to an entry from the constant table from the proto (number/string)

JUMPX.description: jumps to the target offset; like JUMPBACK, supports interruption
details: E: jump offset (-2^23..2^23; 0 means "next instruction" aka "don't jump")

FASTCALL.description: perform a fast call of a built-in function
details: C: jump offset to get to following CALL
FASTCALL is followed by one of (GETIMPORT, MOVE, GETUPVAL) instructions and by CALL instruction
This is necessary so that if FASTCALL can't perform the call inline, it can continue normal execution
If FASTCALL *can* perform the call, it jumps over the instructions *and* over the next CALL
Note that FASTCALL will read the actual call arguments, such as argument/result registers and counts, from the CALL instruction

COVERAGE.description: update coverage information stored in the instruction
details: E: hit count for the instruction (0..2^23-1)
The hit count is incremented by VM every time the instruction is executed, and saturates at 2^23-1

CAPTURE.description: capture a local or an upvalue as an upvalue into a newly created closure; only valid after NEWCLOSURE
details: B: source register (for VAL/REF) or upvalue index (for UPVAL/UPREF)

SUBRK.description: compute arithmetic operation between the constant and a source register and put the result into target register
details: B: constant table index (0..255); must refer to a number

DIVRK.description: compute arithmetic operation between the constant and a source register and put the result into target register
details: B: constant table index (0..255); must refer to a number

FASTCALL1.description: perform a fast call of a built-in function using 1 register argument
details: C: jump offset to get to following CALL

FASTCALL2.description: perform a fast call of a built-in function using 2 register arguments
details: C: jump offset to get to following CALL
AUX: source register 2 in least-significant byte

FASTCALL2K.description: perform a fast call of a built-in function using 1 register argument and 1 constant argument
details: C: jump offset to get to following CALL

FORGPREP.description: prepare loop variables for a generic for loop, jump to the loop backedge unconditionally
details: A: target register; generic for loops assume a register layout [generator, state, index, variables...]

JUMPXEQKNIL.description: jumps to target offset if the comparison with constant is true (or false, see AUX)
details: D: jump offset (-32768..32767; 1 means "next instruction" aka "don't jump")
AUX: constant value (for boolean) in low bit, NOT flag (that flips comparison result) in high bit

JUMPXEQKB.description: jumps to target offset if the comparison with constant is true (or false, see AUX)
details: D: jump offset (-32768..32767; 1 means "next instruction" aka "don't jump")
AUX: constant value (for boolean) in low bit, NOT flag (that flips comparison result) in high bit

JUMPXEQKN.description: jumps to target offset if the comparison with constant is true (or false, see AUX)
details: D: jump offset (-32768..32767; 1 means "next instruction" aka "don't jump")
AUX: constant table index in low 24 bits, NOT flag (that flips comparison result) in high bit

JUMPXEQKS.description: jumps to target offset if the comparison with constant is true (or false, see AUX)
details: D: jump offset (-32768..32767; 1 means "next instruction" aka "don't jump")
AUX: constant table index in low 24 bits, NOT flag (that flips comparison result) in high bit

IDIV.description: compute floor division between two source registers and put the result into target register

IDIVK.description: IDIVK compute floor division between the source register and a constant and put the result into target register

NEWCLASSMEMBER.description: register this method on a class object.
details: C: initial value of this member. currently must be a function.
AUX: The name of this member as a constant string

CALLFB.description: call specified function with collecting runtime stats in a feedback slot
details: A: register where the function object lives, followed by arguments; results are placed starting from the same register
B: argument count + 1, or 0 to preserve all arguments up to top (MULTRET)
C: result count + 1, or 0 to preserve all values and adjust top (MULTRET)

CMPPROTO.description: check if a register contains a closure with a specified Luau function proto id
details: D: jump offset if proto doesn't match

FASTPCALL.description: perform a fastcall of a built-in protected call function
details: A: protected function id (0 - pcall, 1 - xpcall)
B: number of explicit arguments before a variadic tail
C: jump offset to get to following CALL
B: source register of superclass, or 0xFF if no superclass
C: bottom bit is 1 if the class is open, else 0; upper 7 bits are reserved
AUX: constant table index of unreified class object
